# AdminLTE 3.2.0 CSS-only subset

These four unmodified MIT-licensed style sheets preserve the existing Blessing Skin theme. `LICENSE` is the upstream license. No AdminLTE JavaScript, installer, editor, third-party widgets, or AdminLTE npm dependency is shipped. The application implements sidebar/navigation controls locally. This compatibility theme and the Bootstrap 4 runtime are not actively maintained; a theme redesign should replace both together.

Source: <https://registry.npmjs.org/admin-lte/-/admin-lte-3.2.0.tgz>. Archive checked against published SRI `sha512-IDUfoU8jo9DVlB59lDEASAJXTesAEXDZ68DOHI3qg93r5ehVTkMl2x0ixgIyff8NiHeNYXpcOZh3tr6oGbvu9g==` before extracting only the four files in `package/dist/css/alt/` and `package/LICENSE`.
